subject: Request: Roll up commits + Q2 strawman for pipe-to-quota gap
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Roll up commits + Q2 strawman for pipe-to-quota gap

Team —

Quick ask to get ahead of Friday’s finance review: I pulled a strawman coverage model for Q2 attached (Q2-coverage-strawman.xlsx). High level: we’re showing ~2.1x pipe-to-quota against a target coverage of 3.5x, which leaves a shortfall of roughly $45M in ARR that we need to address with commit-level adjustments and confirmed deals.

What I need from each of you by EOD Wednesday (4/14):
- Update stage for any deals that have changed in the last 7 days (Committed, Verbal, In Negotiation, Best Case).
- For committed deals include a single-line commit expectation (amount + committed close date).
- If you have new deals that move from best-case into forecast, add them to the "commit-rollup.csv" tab.

Notes/assumptions in the strawman: win-prob by stage is conservative (Committed=90%, Verbal=60%, Negotiation=35%, Best Case=10%). I’ve highlighted the top 12 opportunities contributing to the gap — please review and correct if I missed recent changes.

Attachments: Q2-coverage-strawman.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Next steps: I’ll consolidate updates into v2 and send to finance for the Friday review. If anyone needs a quick 15-min sync, I can do short slots Wednesday morning.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Roll up commits + Q2 strawman for pipe-to-quota gap

Thanks Ben — will do. A couple quick clarifications:

1) When you say "Committed" for the spreadsheet, are we using the standard definition (contract signed + PO/approval in-hand) or are we allowing "Verbal timeout" as committed for quota calls? Finance and I prefer signed/PO for anything labeled "Committed" in the rollup.
2) Can you add a column for "rep confidence (1-5)" so we can weight subjective confidence separate from the win-prob used in the model?

I’ll update my book by EOD Wednesday and flag anything I can push to contract this week.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>

Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Roll up commits + Q2 strawman for pipe-to-quota gap

Appreciate the proactivity, Ben. A couple of asks from the finance side before we consolidate:

- Please treat "Committed" strictly as contract-executed OR signed PO received. If you have a verbal that you think will convert this quarter, mark it as "Verbal" and include expected close date and any gating items.
- I attached a short reference doc (Definitions_and_rules.pdf) that standardizes stage definitions and the weight we apply to each stage for planning.
- For the rollup, submit a simple CSV (commit-rollup.csv) with columns: deal_id, account_name, rep, amount, stage, expected_close_date, evidence_link. Evidence_link can be a DocuSign, signed PDF or email thread.

If we can get that by EOD Wednesday finance will be able to produce a waterfall and sensitivity view for Friday’s finance review.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Definitions_and_rules.pdf]

FYI — I updated the strawman with a first pass of rep inputs and cleaned the top-opps list. See attachments: Q2-coverage-strawman-v2.xlsx and commit-rollup.csv. Highlights below:

- Adjusted coverage to 2.35x after rep updates (still short vs 3.5x).
- Moved 3 deals from Best Case -> Negotiation based on demos/terms agreed; none meet finance "Committed" definition yet (no signed PO).
- Top two deals that would close the gap are: ACME-ENT-101 ($12.5M expected, closing late May) and ACME-DS-77 ($9.8M, push to June). Both have redlined SOWs in progress.

Action items:
- Laura/Marissa: confirm whether any of your top-12 have legal/contract blockers that prevent signing this quarter.
- Everyone: add evidence_link to the CSV for any deal you mark as "Committed" or "Verbal".

I booked a 30-min slot Thursday 4/15 at 09:00 PT to walk the waterfall with finance — invite pending. If that conflicts, reply with alternate times.

Attachments: Q2-coverage-strawman-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), commit-rollup.csv (csv)

—Ben
